title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
statement:
Given an unsorted array of integers, find the length of the longest consecutive elements sequence.

A consecutive sequence is formed by consecutive integers. For example, the sequence [100, 4, 200, 1, 3, 2] contains the consecutive sequence [1, 2, 3, 4] of length 4.

visibleExamples.explanation: The longest consecutive sequence is [1, 2, 3, 4] with length 4.
The longest consecutive sequence is [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8] with length 9.
An empty array has no consecutive sequence, so the answer is 0.
